title: QUIZ - 04
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Apply sign rules when adding or subtracting signed integers
questions.question: Calculate: \( 6 - (-12) \)
questions.explanation: Evaluating \( 6 - (-12) \) gives 18, applying the rule that combining signed numbers keeps track of direction on the number line.
questions.hint: Think of positive numbers as steps right and negative numbers as steps left on a number line.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the sign of a product of several signed numbers by counting negative factors
questions.question: Without fully computing it, what is the sign of the product \( (-1) \times (-6) \times (-5) \times (-6) \)?
questions.explanation: There are 4 negative factor(s) among 4 numbers. An even number of negative factors produces a positive product, and an odd number produces a negative product. Since there are 4 negative factors, the product is positive.
questions.hint: Count the negative factors: an even count gives a positive product, an odd count gives a negative product.

questions.learningObjective: Apply sign rules when multiplying or dividing signed integers
questions.question: Evaluate: \( -6 \times -3 \)
questions.explanation: The two numbers have the same signs, so the result is positive. Computing the magnitude gives 18, so \( -6 \times -3 \) = 18.
questions.hint: Determine the sign first using the sign rules, then compute the magnitude.

questions.concept: Sign Rules for Multiplication and Division
questions.learningObjective: Determine the sign of a result when a positive number is multiplied by a negative number
questions.question: If a positive number is multiplied by a negative number, what is the sign of the result?

options.label: D
options.text: The sign cannot be determined without knowing the exact numbers.

questions.explanation: Two numbers with different signs, when multiplied or divided, produce a negative result. Here one factor is positive and the other is negative, so the signs are different and the result is negative.
questions.hint: Same signs give a positive result; different signs give a negative result.
